decisions.statement: an internalBuildState of MISSING_EXPORT_COMPLIANCE counts as blocked rather than as still waiting
a read of App Store Connect that fails is retried at the next interval
three read failures in a row raise the error rather than being retried again
a read that answers resets the count of failures in a row to zero
a build App Store Connect has not yet listed is carried as a state of its own
each tick says how long the poll has run and when the poll gives up
the processing poll gives up after 30 minutes
the tester-visibility poll gives up after 10 minutes
a processing failure is emitted as a single-line JSON marker beside its prose message

definition: the polling loop that carries an uploaded build from processing to tester-visible
